queue_context.basis: DERIVED: sum of active project rows located in this state across every ISO queue that lists them (DC Hub interconnect_queue, row level). A state total: it includes other ISOs' parts of the state and only the rows each ISO lists with project detail. Not an ISO-reported figure.

by_iso.as_of_kind: when DC Hub loaded the rows

queue_context.caveat: congestion pressure only — this feed has no commercial-operation dates and most queued MW historically never completes

interconnect_queue.feed: CAISO Public Queue Report (DC Hub interconnect_queue)
interconnect_queue.vintage_note: recency shown as the newest queue-entry date the feed carries
